title: Entrance Antiphon - 23rd Sunday OT
author: Psalm 119:137, 124
snippet: You are just, O Lord, and your judgment is right; treat your servant in accord with your merciful love.

title: Responsorial Psalm 23rd Sunday OT(A)
author: Psalm 95: 1-2, 6-7, 8-9
snippet: If today you hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

title: Gospel Acclamation
author: 2 Corinthians 5:19
snippet: God was reconciling, the world to himself in Christ, and entrusting to us the message of salvation.

title: Come, Worship the Lord
author: John Michael Talbot
snippet: Come, and worship the Lord, for we are his people, the flock that he shepherds. Alleluia.

title: Communion Antiphon - 23rd Sunday OT
author: Psalm 42 (41):2-3
snippet: Like the deer that yearns for running streams, so my soul is yearning for you, my God; my should is thirsting for God, the living God.

title: We Come to You
author: Josh Blakesley
snippet: By Your body and blood, by Your life and Your love; renew us. May Your sacrifice be forgiveness in me; heal us.

title: As the Deer Longs
author: Bob Hurd
snippet: As the deer longs for running streams, so I long, so I long, so I long for you.

title: Our God is Good
author: Joshua Blakesley and Cooper Ray.
snippet: Our God is good! Our God is good! Holy and righteous, powerful and true

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
